newsitem.title: USA: Coconino acquires Uinta Oil & Gas.
newsitem.headline: Coconino acquires Uinta Oil & Gas.

text.p: Coconino SMA Inc said it acquired privately-held Uinta Gas & Oil Inc of Roosevelt, Utah, for 185,000 restricted common shares.

Uinta owns and operates 19 productive oil and natural gas wells, 107 oil and natural gas well locations, and 15 re-work well locations in northeastern Utah. The company also provides operating, geological, and engineering services to outside operators and well owners.
Uinta's property covers some 18,960 acres in the Uinta Basin, which offers oil-rich geological structures.
Cococonino said Uinta's recoverable reserves total more than 57 million barrels of oil and more than 1.6 million barrel-oil-equivalent of natural gas.
Uinta has reported, on an unaudited basis, gross revenues of $879,704 for 1995. For the eight months period ended August 31, revenues totaled $1,091,283.
Cococonino said Uinta is operating profitably or near-profitably, and will have no long term debt.
